# `<ptfkit/myeni2021.h>`

```c
#include <ptfkit/myeni2021.h>
```

Myeni et al. (2021) point water-retention PTFs for South African soils.

## Source

Myeni, L., Mdlambuzi, T., Paterson, D. G., De Nysschen, G., & Moeletsi, M. E. (2021). Development and evaluation of pedotransfer functions to estimate soil moisture content at field capacity and permanent wilting point for South African soils. Water, 13(19), 2639. https://doi.org/10.3390/w13192639

[DOI: 10.3390/w13192639](https://doi.org/10.3390/w13192639)

## Scope

**Territory:** South Africa

**Dataset:** 6,307 soil horizons from the South African national soil database after quality control; 3,171 horizons were used for development and 3,136 for independent validation.

[PTF catalog page](../../../ptf-catalog/sources/myeni2021.md)

## `myeni2021_ptf_result`

```c
typedef struct {
    double field_capacity;
    double permanent_wilting_point;
 } myeni2021_ptf_result;
```

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `field_capacity` | Gravimetric soil moisture content at field capacity, corresponding to -33 kPa matric potential. (kg/kg) |
| `permanent_wilting_point` | Gravimetric soil moisture content at permanent wilting point, corresponding to -1500 kPa matric potential. (kg/kg) |

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_myeni2021` {#function-calc_ptf_myeni2021}

Estimate field capacity and permanent wilting point for South African soils.

```c
static inline myeni2021_ptf_result calc_ptf_myeni2021(double clay, double silt, double soil_organic_carbon);
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clay` | in | Clay content by mass for particles smaller than 0.002 mm. (%) |
| `silt` | in | Silt content by mass for particles from 0.002 to 0.05 mm. (%) |
| `soil_organic_carbon` | in | Soil organic carbon content by mass measured by the Walkley-Black method. (%) |

#### Returns

A `myeni2021_ptf_result` value.

!!! note

    Table 5 reports development R-squared values of 0.73 for field capacity and 0.79 for permanent wilting point.

!!! note

    Independent validation gave R-squared values of 0.77 and 0.82 and RMSE values of 0.047 kg/kg and 0.029 kg/kg for field capacity and permanent wilting point, respectively.

!!! note

    The source equations use clay, silt, and soil organic carbon as mass percentages and directly return gravimetric water content in kg/kg.

!!! warning

    Apply outside South Africa only with caution and in regions with similar soil types and climatic conditions.

!!! warning

    The regressions were developed from disturbed samples and do not explicitly account for soil structure through bulk density.
